scenario_summary: Customer is disputing an unrecognized $76 charge on their account and requesting a refund if unauthorized.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Minh Nguyen and I'm 69. I noticed a $76 charge on my account from two days ago that I don't recognize. I haven't made any recent purchases that I can think of, though it's possible I forgot about something small. Can you look into it, and if it turns out I really didn't authorize it, can you refund it?

Hello Minh, I can certainly help you look into that charge today. To get started, could you please provide your account number and the last four digits of your social security number for verification?
Sure, my account number is 88492011 and the last four are 4492.
Thank you. Just to make sure I have the right account, could you also confirm your full billing address?
Perfect, thank you. I see a charge for $76.00 from 'Global Tech Services' dated two days ago. Does that name ring a bell at all?
No, I've never heard of Global Tech Services. I don't buy things online very often.

I understand. Per our standard terms, I can initiate a dispute for unauthorized transactions, but I need to confirm you haven't shared your card details with anyone else who might have used it. Have you?
No, I keep my card in my wallet and never share it.
Okay, I've gone ahead and opened a formal dispute for this $76 transaction. You should see the provisional credit applied to your account within 24 hours while we investigate the merchant.

resolution_summary: Agent verified the customer's identity, confirmed the unrecognized merchant, and initiated a formal dispute with a provisional credit.
